title: Fully-dynamic X.509 enrollment over 2-hop TSCH (server reconstructs DER at runtime)

test.description: Line topology, 50 m spacing (tx_range 55 -> 2 hops). node1 = CA/EDHOC responder + RPL root + TSCH coordinator built ENROLL_X509_DYN=1 (runtime x509_encode_full_cert reconstruction); node2 = relay; node3 = X.509 enroll client. Compares against the static-blob 2-hop arm: does the runtime-reconstructed (~288 B) X.509 flight reassemble over two hops, like the static (~339 B) one did not?
